summary: Shows the documented carrier signal connection between an assigned phase conductor and earth-referenced coupling equipment.
description: Shows the documented carrier signal connection between an assigned phase conductor and earth-referenced coupling equipment. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Assigned phase and coupling unit” at the input and “Phase-to-earth carrier path” at the output. The arrangement does not define a coupling frequency.
